update.title: Polished Daily Check-In for fast, one-screen use
update.summary: Added flicker-free day navigation and guarded autosave, then simplified the mobile form so a complete check-in fits on one screen.

blocks.body:
## Move between days without losing work

Day changes use local state and cached entries, avoiding a full screen remount when the user swipes or taps between dates. A guarded two-second autosave records genuine edits, while navigation flushes pending changes before loading the next entry.

blocks.label: Daily Check-In: the form and local document model

blocks.code:
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> Loading
  Loading --> Ready: initialize without saving
  Ready --> Dirty: user edit
  Dirty --> Ready: debounced save
  Dirty --> Loading: save before navigation
  Ready --> Loading: change day
blocks.description: Daily Check-In separates initialization from user edits, debounces ordinary saves, and flushes pending changes before day navigation. Loading an entry does not count as an edit; only user changes enter the autosave path, and navigation saves pending work before changing days.

blocks.body:
## Keep the whole routine on one screen

The manual save button and visible settings control were removed from the main form, with settings available from a long press on the date. Tighter spacing and keyboard dismissal keep the check-in usable without extra scrolling.

## Keep displayed and stored time aligned

The sleep-time handle, labels, duration, and stored value share the same 15-minute snap calculation. The value shown after a drag is the value written to the daily record.
